queries: select supplier_id, strftime(date_trunc('week',order_date),'%m-%d') w, count(*) n, round(avg(is_late::int),2) late_rate, round(avg(delay_days),1) d from purchase_order group by 1,2 order by 1,2
select p.supplier_id, strftime(date_trunc('week',c.date),'%m-%d') w, count(*) n from complaint c join product p on p.id=c.product_id group by 1,2 order by 1,2
select p.supplier_id, strftime(date_trunc('week',l.date),'%m-%d') w, count(*) n, sum(l.quantity*l.unit_price) v from lost_sale l join product p on p.id=l.product_id group by 1,2 order by 1,2
